pairs: The burden that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
O Lord, shall I cry out,
Shall I shout to you while suffering violence,
Quare ostendisti mihi iniquitatem et laborem,
Why have you revealed to me iniquity and hardship,
videre prædam et injustitiam contra me?
to see plunder and injustice opposite me?
but the opposition is more powerful.
Because of this, the law has been torn apart,
et non pervenit usque ad finem judicium;
and judgment does not persevere to its conclusion.
For the impious prevail against the just.
Because of this, a perverse judgment is issued.
quia opus factum est in diebus vestris,
For a work has been done in your days,
which no one will believe when it is told.
I will raise up the Chaldeans,
marching across the width of the earth,
to possess tabernacles not their own.
ex semetipsa judicium et onus ejus egredietur.
From themselves, judgment and their burden will issue.
Their horses are more nimble than leopards and swifter than wolves in the evening;
And then their horsemen will approach from far away;
equites namque ejus de longe venient;
they will fly like the eagle,
volabunt quasi aquila festinans ad comedendum.
They will all approach towards the prey;
their face is like a burning wind.
And they will gather captives together like sand.
and sovereign rulers will be his laughingstock,
and he will laugh over every fortress,
and he will transport a rampart and seize it.
Then his spirit will be altered,
hæc est fortitudo ejus dei sui.
Such is his strength from his god.
Numquid non tu a principio, Domine,
Have you not existed from the beginning,
and so we shall not die? Lord,
you have stationed him for judgment,
et fortem, ut corriperes, fundasti eum.
and you have established that his strength will be swept away.
et respicere ad iniquitatem non poteris.
and you cannot look towards iniquity.
Why do you look upon the agents of iniquity, and remain silent,
et taces devorante impio justiorem se?
while the impious is devouring one who is more just than himself?
Et facies homines quasi pisces maris,
And you will make men like the fish of the sea
et quasi reptile non habens principem.
and like the creeping things that have no ruler.
He lifted up everything with his hook.
He drew them in with his dragnet,
and gathered them into his netting.
For this reason, he will offer victims to his dragnet,
and he will sacrifice to his netting.
quia in ipsis incrassata est pars ejus,
For through them, his portion has been made fat,
Propter hoc ergo expandit sagenam suam, et semper interficere gentes non parcet.
Because of this, therefore, he expands his dragnet and will not be lenient in continually putting to death the peoples.
